title: AKOS workflow frontmatter (optional)
description: None of the 9 workflows/*.md files have YAML frontmatter today — they open directly with '# Workflow: ...'. Every field here is optional and the schema itself has no required list, so a file with no leading '---' block is valid (checked as a legacy-format file, an informational note rather than a warning or error — it never claimed to have frontmatter). No automated migration backfills this; it's added by hand per-workflow if/when a workflow needs machine routing.
